description.value: CCTV Chinese Restaurant sits on Marine Drive in White Rock's popular waterfront tourist corridor, its name an acronym for China, Canada, Tsingtao, and Vancouver. Owner-chef Shi Lilong trained at Chinese culinary schools specializing in Shandong cuisine and earned recognition including a Healthy Dining certificate and a top-five ranking in the 2015 'Best Asian Food in Canada' competition. The broad menu spans seafood, lamb, pork, beef, cold dishes, and hand-crafted tofu, with online ordering available.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website fully confirms the OSM address (15015 Marine Dr, White Rock, BC V4B 1C3) and provides a phone number ((604) 538-1436) absent from OSM. An 'ONLINE ORDER' link on the homepage constitutes positive evidence for takeout. No website content addresses bike parking, water refill, washrooms, Wi-Fi, or other cycling amenities, so those remain null; OSM's outdoor_seating=yes tag is not corroborated by website text and cannot be treated as authoritative for patio-visibility bike parking.
concerns: Two different email addresses appear across website pages: cctvlong@hotmail.com on the front/index pages and cctv@gmail.com on subpages (/about, /contact, /menu, /chef) — the primary contact email is ambiguous.
OSM record contains no phone number; phone value taken from website only (contact_confirmed.phone set to null as there is no OSM value to corroborate).
Website copyright dated 2021; content may not be fully current, though the business does not appear closed.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: A well-established sit-down restaurant on White Rock's Marine Drive waterfront tourist corridor; a natural meal stop for cyclists riding the coastal route.

wow_evidence: top-five ranking in the 2015 'Best Asian Food in Canada' competition
